features.stakeholderBenefit: Customers quickly find vehicles at their desired location, reducing search friction and improving booking conversion. Supports both planned trips and spontaneous rentals

features.name: Map-Based Vehicle Discovery
features.description: Interactive map interface displaying available vehicles with real-time markers, walking distance estimates, vehicle clustering, zoom/pan controls, filter vehicles on map, and direct navigation
features.stakeholderBenefit: Visual, intuitive discovery especially valuable for urban users and peer-to-peer platforms. Enables location-based decision making

features.name: Date & Time Availability Search
features.description: Precise rental period specification with calendar/time pickers, duration calculation, real-time availability checking, visual availability calendar, blocked dates display, and buffer time enforcement
features.stakeholderBenefit: Customers see only available vehicles for their exact timeframe, preventing booking failures and disappointment

features.name: Granular Multi-Criteria Filtering
features.description: Comprehensive filtering by vehicle type, transmission, category, capacity, specific features, fuel policy, price range, mileage, supplier, rating, and accessibility with multiple filter categories
features.stakeholderBenefit: Customers efficiently find vehicles matching specific needs without browsing irrelevant options. Critical for users with accessibility requirements or specific feature needs

features.name: Intelligent Search Results Sorting
features.description: Multiple sorting algorithms including price, distance, rating, popularity, newest, recommended (AI-powered), availability, and eco-friendly options

sources.section: Requirement VS-5: Intelligent Search Results Sorting

features.stakeholderBenefit: Customers prioritize results based on their decision criteria (budget, quality, convenience, sustainability)

features.name: Augmented Reality Vehicle Showroom
features.description: AR technology to project 3D vehicle models into physical environment with 360-degree rotation, walk around, interior inspection, legroom/cargo space viewing, size gauging, and side-by-side comparison

sources.section: Requirement VS-6: Augmented Reality Vehicle Showroom

features.stakeholderBenefit: Experience seekers and luxury customers can inspect vehicles virtually before booking, increasing confidence and reducing post-booking surprises. Particularly valuable for high-value rentals

features.name: Voice-First Search Interface
features.description: Natural language voice interface for hands-free search with NLP, integration with Alexa Automotive and Android Auto, voice-based filtering, spoken results, and multi-turn conversation support
features.stakeholderBenefit: Drivers can search and book while driving safely. Accessibility benefit for visually impaired users. Convenience for power renters who value speed

features.name: AI-Powered Personalized Recommendations
features.description: Machine learning algorithms analyzing user behavior, trip intent, seasonal patterns, location, similar users, real-time context, and price sensitivity to surface relevant vehicles with multiple recommendation types
features.stakeholderBenefit: Reduces search time by surfacing relevant options. Increases booking conversion through personalized matching. Enables discovery of vehicles users might not have searched for

features.name: Comprehensive Vehicle Details
features.description: Rich, detailed information display including specifications, capacity, technical details, features, pricing, insurance options, additional services, supplier info, availability calendar, image gallery, reviews, environmental info, and accessibility features
features.stakeholderBenefit: Customers have complete information to make confident decisions. Reduces support inquiries and booking modifications

features.name: Vehicle Reviews & Ratings System
features.description: Comprehensive customer feedback with star ratings, written reviews, rating categories, review photos, verified bookings, review sorting, helpful votes, host responses, and review moderation
features.stakeholderBenefit: Make informed decisions based on authentic previous customer experiences. Builds trust and transparency in the platform

features.name: Supplier Directory & Profiles
features.description: Browse and evaluate rental suppliers with profiles, filtering, comparison, locations, ratings, response time, cancellation rate, fleet size, and specializations
features.stakeholderBenefit: Customers choose suppliers based on reputation, location coverage, or previous positive experiences. Particularly important for corporate clients with preferred vendor programs

features.name: Environmental Impact Discovery
features.description: Display environmental information including CO2 emissions, fuel type, eco-friendly badge, environmental comparison, carbon offset options, EV range, green routing, and sustainability score
features.stakeholderBenefit: Eco-conscious users can make environmentally responsible choices. Supports corporate sustainability goals and ESG reporting

features.name: Saved Searches & Alerts
features.description: Save frequent searches with custom names, quick access, price drop alerts, availability notifications, email/push preferences, search management, sharing, and search history tracking
features.stakeholderBenefit: Power renters and frequent travelers save time by reusing common searches. Never miss deals on preferred vehicles

features.name: Favorite Vehicles
features.description: Save favorite vehicles for quick access with favorites list, availability notifications, price change alerts, removal, sharing, and favorite history
features.stakeholderBenefit: Easy access to preferred vehicles. Receive alerts when favorites become available or go on sale

features.name: Fast, Responsive Search Experience
features.description: Optimized search performance with real-time results, debounced input, progressive image loading, lazy loading, cached results, optimistic UI, loading skeletons, result count display, and no results state
features.stakeholderBenefit: Smooth, fast search experience reduces frustration and abandonment. Particularly important for mobile users on slower connections

features.name: Voice Interface Support
features.description: Integrate with voice assistants (Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa) for basic operations, support voice commands for search/booking management, provide voice feedback, and test with users with disabilities
features.stakeholderBenefit: Users with visual or motor impairments can use voice commands to search and book vehicles hands-free

features.name: Simplified Interfaces for Cognitive Accessibility
features.description: Provide simplified booking flow with fewer steps, use plain language, provide visual aids, break complex tasks into smaller steps, provide progress indicators, allow saving progress, minimize distractions, and offer prominent help options
features.stakeholderBenefit: Users with cognitive disabilities can complete bookings without being overwhelmed by complex interfaces

features.name: Personalized Accessibility Settings
features.description: Provide accessibility settings panel for customizing text size/font/spacing, color schemes (high contrast, dark mode), disabling animations, adjusting timing, save preferences to user accounts, and provide preset configurations
features.stakeholderBenefit: Users with disabilities can customize accessibility settings to their specific needs for optimal experience

features.name: Multi-Step Booking Creation
features.description: Complete vehicle reservation through a clear, guided multi-step checkout process with progress indication, validation, and state preservation

requirementDetails.userStory: As an individual customer, I want to complete a vehicle reservation through a clear, guided process

features.name: Flexible Pricing and Discount Application
features.description: Support multiple pricing modes (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, per-km, unlimited) with real-time calculation, discount code validation, loyalty points redemption, and transparent pricing breakdown

sources.section: Requirement 4: Flexible Pricing and Discount Application

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want to see transparent pricing with multiple rental duration options and apply available discounts

features.name: Booking History and Tracking
features.description: Chronological list of all bookings with status indicators, filtering, search, export capabilities, and complete history maintenance

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want to view all my bookings with status tracking and filtering

features.name: Booking Templates and Favorites
features.description: Save booking configurations as reusable templates with vehicle preferences, insurance selections, extras, locations, and duration for quick booking

requirementDetails.userStory: As a frequent renter, I want to save booking configurations as templates

features.name: Accessible Booking Interface
features.description: WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliant booking interface with screen reader support, keyboard navigation, voice control, sufficient color contrast, and assistive technology compatibility

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer with disabilities, I want an accessible booking interface

features.name: Payment History and Transaction Records
features.description: Complete transaction history with search, filtering, PDF receipts, refund tracking, failed attempts, export to CSV/Excel, and expense management tool integration (Concur, Expensify, QuickBooks)

sources.section: REQ-PP-010: Payment History and Transaction Records

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want detailed receipts and transaction history

features.name: Multi-Step Booking Checkout
features.description: Guided booking workflow with customer information collection, insurance selection, additional services, payment processing, and confirmation

features.name: Customer Information Pre-Fill
features.description: Auto-populate customer details for logged-in users including name, email, phone, license information with edit capability

features.name: Real-Time Form Validation
features.description: Inline validation of email format, phone numbers, driver's license expiration, and age requirements during booking

features.name: Additional Driver Management
features.description: Add multiple authorized drivers with license validation, age verification, and automatic fee calculation

features.name: Insurance Coverage Selection
features.description: Present insurance options (CDW, TP, PAI, SLI) with clear descriptions, coverage limits, costs, and comparison features

sources.section: Workflow Steps - Insurance and Protection Selection

features.name: Additional Services and Equipment Rental
features.description: Select optional equipment (GPS, child seats, ski racks) and services (prepaid fuel, toll passes, WiFi) with availability confirmation

sources.section: Workflow Steps - Additional Services and Equipment

features.name: Booking Summary Review
features.description: Complete itemized breakdown of all charges including base rate, insurance, fees, taxes with edit capability for each section

features.name: Promotional Code Application
features.description: Validate and apply discount codes with eligibility checking, automatic price recalculation, and error handling for invalid codes

features.name: Terms and Conditions Acceptance
features.description: Display and require acceptance of rental agreement, cancellation policy, privacy policy with timestamp and IP recording

sources.section: Workflow Steps - Terms and Conditions Acceptance

features.name: Booking Confirmation Delivery
features.description: Immediate confirmation via email and SMS with booking reference, pickup instructions, and downloadable PDF

features.name: Payment Method Display
features.description: Show available payment options (credit/debit cards, digital wallets, pay-at-counter) with security badges and saved methods for logged-in users

features.name: Payment Decline Handling
features.description: User-friendly decline messages with corrective action suggestions and option to try alternative payment methods

features.name: Digital Receipt Generation
features.description: Automated receipt creation with transaction details, itemized charges, and PDF download/email delivery

features.name: Digital Check-In System
features.description: Pre-arrival check-in with document upload, contract review, and express pickup option to skip counter lines

features.name: Location-Based Vehicle Search
features.description: Search available vehicles by pickup/return location with auto-complete suggestions and geolocation support

features.name: Date and Time Selection
features.description: Calendar picker for pickup/return dates with time selection in 30-minute increments and rental duration calculation

features.name: Multi-Criteria Filtering
features.description: Filter search results by price range, vehicle type, transmission, capacity, features, fuel policy, and supplier

features.name: Vehicle Comparison Tool
features.description: Side-by-side comparison of up to 4 vehicles showing specifications, features, pricing, and supplier ratings

features.name: Search Result Sorting
features.description: Sort vehicles by price, rating, popularity, newest additions, or supplier name with preserved filters

features.name: Detailed Vehicle Information Page
features.description: Comprehensive vehicle details with image gallery, specifications, pricing breakdown, reviews, availability calendar, and environmental info
